summary: A leader has a proposed debate agreement read aloud before asking whether anyone objects.
realLife: Riddick recalled drafting consent agreements with Lyndon Johnson’s instructions and hearing the finished terms read to the Senate.
inGame: needs: consent request and its written terms.

turns.what: The leader withdraws the request to revise it.
turns.pulledBy: A member hears an unexpected deadline.
turns.writesBack: A new text goes to the desk.

turns.pulledBy: Nobody objects to the terms read.
turns.writesBack: The floor schedule reflects its terms.
